title: Triggers
intro: Jobs an agent does on its own on a date or on repeat: recheck an update, see if something is ready at 5am, confirm a backup. You are not watching when it runs, so it follows your rules (the "When I run without you" document) and only tells you when there is something to say.

empty.title: No triggers yet
empty.text: Create one here, or ask Jarvis ("every day at 5am check if updates are ready"). Update studies, "recheck later" and task comments also show up here.

when.onNewUpdate: When a new update appears (apps and server)

alerts.running: Running. The result shows up here when the agent finishes.

modal.title: New trigger
modal.updateText: "{{title}}": when the time comes, the update goes back to study. Here you only change the date and the alerts.
modal.name: Name
modal.instructionPlaceholder: E.g. Check for updates in Ready to update and do the ones the rules allow without me.
modal.instructionHint: Write it as if you were asking now: the agent cannot ask you anything while it runs.
modal.timeZone: Lisbon time. In a month without that day, it runs on the last one.
modal.notifyHint: In notifications (site and app), only when there is something to say.
modal.enabledHint: When off, it stays saved but does not run.
modal.tagsHint: Enter or comma to add (e.g. updates, backups).
modal.toChat: Put the answer in a Jarvis conversation
modal.toChatHint: Each time it runs, the answer goes to a new Assistant conversation and you get a notice (e.g. a daily summary).
modal.onNewUpdateHint: No time: it runs whenever MyHomeLab sees a new version of an app or the server, once per version, with the updates in the request.

filters.search: Search the name or the text

detail.tagsHint: To filter the list. Agents also add tags when they create triggers.
detail.historyHint: The last times it ran, with what the agent answered.
